driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%.
description_measured: Patch spells, magic effects, enchantments, staves, and scrolls for Requiem's Magic Redone via houseCARL — school, tier, magicka cost, magnitude, and the tier-classifier perk derived from Requiem's comparable magic, emitted as an ESP override. Use for any MGEF, SPEL, or ENCH record whose cost, power, or tome value breaks Requiem's magic economy. Load before the record is touched.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies; every judge's reasoning ended on the same entry as its choice token, so no §6.5 step-4 overrides were applied. Both recall misses are substantive routing decisions, not token slips: q8 and q10 each explicitly considered E, named E's magic-economy scope, and deliberately routed elsewhere because the underlying record was AMMO / ALCH. Pattern worth noting for description tuning: E's specificity is strong (9/9, including three NONE routes on cosmetic-asset, SkyPatcher-INI, and gameplay-advice queries, plus a clean K/E split on the staff-as-WEAP case at q11), and the recall losses both come from queries where magic-effect language sits on a non-magic record type — E's derivation surface ("comparable magic", school/tier/cost/tome value) is reading as a hard record-class fence.

Judge treated the poison as an ALCH record: magnitude/duration live on the potion's effect entries, so C (Alchemy Redone comparables, override is final balance) beat E, which it scoped to the spell/enchantment economy rather than alchemy consumables.
